items.title: JPMorgan says stronger AI revenue makes capex boom more economically viable
items.summary: JPMorgan believes faster revenue growth across the artificial intelligence industry is making the huge wave of infrastructure investment underpinning the sector look increasingly sustainable from an economic perspective. “The recent acceleration in AI companies’ revenues makes the AI capex cycle look more economically viable than it did six months ago,” strategist Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou wrote in a note to clients.
